Question B-001-015-004.

Why the correct answer is right: The bank states that certificate holders may operate radio-controlled models on all amateur bands above 30 MHz.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "if the control transmitter does not exceed 15 kHz of occupied bandwidth": A 15 kHz occupied-bandwidth condition is not the model-control privilege answer.
- sourceIndex 2: "on all amateur radio bands below 30 MHz": Below-30-MHz bands are not the model-control permission stated by the official answer.
- sourceIndex 3: "if only pulse modulation is used": The privilege is not limited to pulse modulation.
